note: Contracts bind generic templates (T1, T2, T4, descriptive totals) to reviewed records. The engine evaluates predicates and branches; it never branches on a mission name. Critical predicate rule: any contradicted -> 'contradicted' branch; else any unknown -> 'unknown' branch; else 'satisfied' branch. Non-critical predicates add missing requirements only. Amendment A-001 (14 Nov 2026): the later-response plan uses route conditional_model_candidate with outcome specified_conditional_comparison.

records.permittedUse: Specify a comparison of the later remote CO2 response of the published Saffire VI transport model

requirements.description: The documented initial alignment is a constant additive shift to each sensor's initial value
Synchronized measured and modelled remote CO2 series are acquired (needed only for numerical scoring)

satisfied.text: Compare the later remote CO2 response, conditional on the fire source supplied to the model and on the documented initial alignment. Because each curve was shifted additively to its sensor's initial value, the aligned residual equals the response-change residual (T1): the comparison tests change after the start, not the initial agreement.

unknown.text: The alignment transform is not documented well enough to apply the additive identity; the comparison specification stays unresolved until it is.

contradicted.text: The documented alignment is not a constant additive shift, so the T1 identity does not apply to this comparison.

records.permittedConclusionTemplate: Conditional response comparison under a documented additive initial alignment.
forbiddenClaims: Initial agreement counts as predictive success
Any RMSE or score (no synchronized series acquired)

records.permittedUse: Assess the published transport model as a predictor of chemical heat release from burning

requirements.description: The model predicts chemical heat release
The model's heat quantity (HAR integral) and calorimetry measure the same quantity

satisfied.text: The model predicts chemical heat release.

unknown.text: Whether the model predicts chemical heat release is not established in the reviewed records.

contradicted.text: This transport model receives the fire as prescribed MGR and HAR sources (S-VI p.3); it does not predict burning or chemical heat release. Its {obs:OBS-SVI6-HAR-TOTAL} is sensible heat added to the cabin, not oxygen-consumption calorimetry ({obs:OBS-SVI6-CAL-THR}, S-CAL Table 2): the units match but the quantities do not, so their ratio is not an accuracy or efficiency. A burning prediction would need a model that predicts burning, compared against a matched calorimetry definition, boundary and window.

records.permittedConclusionTemplate: Different physical quantity; useful alternative is the conditional remote-response comparison.
forbiddenClaims: 497/1280 is a heat-release accuracy or efficiency
Same kJ unit means the same quantity

records.permittedUse: Descriptively compare the source-input and remote-inferred CO2 totals for the SIBAL burn

requirements.description: The remote-inferred total is a positive reported value
Both totals are the same quantity (CO2 mass)

satisfied.text: The source-input total ({obs:OBS-SVI5-SOURCE-TOTAL}) and the remote-inferred total ({obs:OBS-SVI5-REMOTE-TOTAL}) differ by {dv:DV-SIBAL-DIFF} ({dv:DV-SIBAL-REL} relative to the remote total). The authors note steady-state agreement is expected from the source total and report that the model underpredicts the rise at all locations, so a close total says nothing by itself about the transient response.

contradicted.text: The totals are not the same quantity.

records.permittedConclusionTemplate: Descriptive closeness of integrated totals only.
forbiddenClaims: Accurate transient dynamics from a close total

records.permittedUse: Check the published source normalization arithmetic for Saffire V event 6

requirements.description: The unscaled source total M0 is positive
M0 and the target total M* are the same quantity (CO2 mass)
The integration window W of the source total is stated

satisfied.text: The reported factor is consistent with the reported totals: M*/M0 = {dv:DV-T2-RATIO}, and M0 × reported factor = {dv:DV-T2-PRODUCT}, {dv:DV-T2-RESID} from M*. The arithmetic uses already-rounded published numbers; that small difference is a rounding effect, not a model error.

unknown.text: A required total is missing or not positive, so no scale is computed.

contradicted.text: The totals are not the same species/basis, so a normalization ratio is not meaningful.

records.permittedConclusionTemplate: Descriptive arithmetic check of a published normalization.
forbiddenClaims: The 0.018 g difference is a physical or model error
Every downstream cabin output is forced to match
